By means of present writ petition under Article 227 of the Constitution of India, petitioner has put to challenge the judgment and order dated 09.10.2025 passed by learned District Judge, Udham Singh Nagar, in Execution Case No.20 of 2023 PD NHAI Vs. Competent Authority/ Special Land Acquisition, Udham Singh Nagar and Others, whereby, the petitioner was directed to pay the stamp duty upon arbitral amount to the extent it is being executed by petitioner in the aforesaid execution case.
4.

entities.text: Execution Case No.20 of 2023 PD NHAI Vs. Competent Authority/ Special Land Acquisition, Udham Singh Nagar and Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the petitioner argued and submitted that in view of the provision of Section 96 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation &
Resettlement Act, 2013, the exemption has been given for levying on stamp duty upon the award or agreement under this Act.
5.

sentences.text: After reading the aforesaid provision as quoted by learned counsel for petitioner in Para 16 of the writ petition, this Court is prima-facie, satisfied with the submission made by learned counsel for petitioner.

6. Issue notice to respondent No.2, returnable within six weeks.
7.
Steps to be taken within 07 days.
Meanwhile, respondent(s) may file counter affidavit(s).
